answer: Install plugs from the Libraries tab of the Workbench, which you open with the `Libraries: Manager` command. Legacy `plugs:` config entries are ignored in v2. Click **Install…** and enter the plug URI (`https://…` or `github:…`). If the URI ends in `.plug.js`, the installer also asks where to save the plug.

Workbench/Libraries.md-11-
Workbench/Libraries.md-12-* **Filter libraries**: narrows installed libraries by name and available ones by name, description and page.
Workbench/Libraries.md:13:* **Install…**: asks for a library or plug URI (`https://…` or `github:…`) and installs it. For a plug (a URI ending in `.plug.js`) it also asks where to save it.
Workbench/Libraries.md-14-* **Add repository…**: asks for a [[Repository]] URI and the page to put it on, then adds it so its libraries show up under Available.
Workbench/Libraries.md-15-* **Check for updates**: compares each installed library and repository with its source, and shows the result beside it (see below).
Workbench/Libraries.md-16-* **Update all**: updates every installed library that can be updated, with progress. It only shows when there is something to update.
Workbench/Libraries.md-17-
Workbench/Libraries.md-18-Below it are three sections, each with its own error and info banner:
Workbench/Libraries.md-19-
Workbench/Libraries.md:20:* **Installed**: the libraries you installed, plus plugs that no library brought along. Built-in libraries (on `Library/Std/` pages, or without a share URI) are marked *built-in* and can’t be updated or removed. Libraries in dev mode are marked *dev mode* and are left alone, too. Click a row to open its page.
Workbench/Libraries.md-21-* **Available**: the libraries your repositories offer, grouped by repository, with the recommended Std repository first. **Install** puts one in your space. Available library titles open their configured website. When no website is configured, the title opens the library’s source page using the browser URL for its URI (for example, expanding a `github:` URI to its GitHub file page).
Workbench/Libraries.md-22-* **Repositories**: the [[Repository|repositories]] you added, with **Update all** to refresh all of them. Any that fail are listed with the reason. The built-in repositories (Std and SilverBulletMD) update like the others but can’t be removed.
